info.title: dotnet-cosmos-migrations
info.description: Command-line tool for ThorstenSauter.Azure.Cosmos.Migrations: apply, roll back, list and scaffold Azure Cosmos DB migrations (dotnet cosmos-migrations).

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a new migration with an EF-style ID (yyyyMMddHHmmss_Name).

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: The folder, relative to the project, to write the migration to; next to the latest migration (or Migrations) by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]

options.name: --id
options.description: Use this ID instead of a timestamp-based one. [Default: null]

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Build a single executable that applies the migrations without the .NET SDK or this tool.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Release"]

options.name: --runtime
options.description: The target runtime identifier, e.g. linux-x64 or linux-arm64; the current one by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --self-contained
options.description: Include the .NET runtime, so the target machine needs none.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file or directory; cosmos-migrations-bundle in the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing bundle.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the migrations in the project, without connecting to a database.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: A prebuilt or published migrations assembly, instead of building a project. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Use the existing build output of the project.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print JSON (id, description, type) instead of a table.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Apply pending migrations, or those up to and including a target.

options.name: --target
options.description: The last migration to apply: its ID, or an EF-style ID's timestamp or name. [Default: null]

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: A prebuilt or published migrations assembly, instead of building a project. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Use the existing build output of the project.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: The Cosmos DB connection string or account endpoint; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION_STRING. [Default: null]

options.name: --connection-name
options.description: Read the connection string from ConnectionStrings__<name>, as .NET Aspire sets it. [Default: null]

options.name: --database
options.description: The database to migrate; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_DATABASE. [Default: null]

options.name: --container
options.description: The container recording applied migrations. [Default: null]

options.name: --lock-timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for another runner's lease. [Default: null]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log debug output.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove the latest migration's source file, after checking it isn't applied to the database.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove without checking the database (e.g. offline, or after rolling it back elsewhere).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: The Cosmos DB connection string or account endpoint; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION_STRING. [Default: null]

options.name: --connection-name
options.description: Read the connection string from ConnectionStrings__<name>, as .NET Aspire sets it. [Default: null]

options.name: --database
options.description: The database to check; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_DATABASE. [Default: null]

options.name: --container
options.description: The container recording applied migrations. [Default: null]

options.name: --project
options.description: The project holding the migrations (a .csproj or its directory); the current directory by default. [Default: null]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: A prebuilt or published migrations assembly, instead of building a project. [Default: null]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [Default: @"Debug"]

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Use the existing build output of the project.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: The Cosmos DB connection string or account endpoint; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION_STRING. [Default: null]

options.name: --connection-name
options.description: Read the connection string from ConnectionStrings__<name>, as .NET Aspire sets it. [Default: null]

options.name: --database
options.description: The database to migrate; also read from COSMOS_MIGRATIONS_DATABASE. [Default: null]

options.name: --container

options.name: --verbose
